thesis: Trademarks preserve identifiable responsibility and prevent confusion, not monopolies over content or functions.
role: Distinguish branding, affiliation and truthful reference.

ideas.statement: Marks identify source within relevant goods, use and territories; registration is not quality certification and needs clearance, use and maintenance evidence.
Truthful criticism and compatibility references differ from false affiliation; interfaces need evidenced relationships rather than word blacklists or cosmetic disclaimers.
Trademark cannot replace a failed copyright claim or guarantee margins; genuine review, maintenance and correction make responsibility valuable.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: US single-work title registration practice is not a universal rule that titles lack protection; Dastar does not permit deceptive affiliations.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
